## /rebar-debug report — RESOLVED (commit cf88b2ef26, pushed to Gerrit pending Verified+LLM-Review)

**Problem** — `preview` and legacy `--mode dry-run` passes (both documented no-write) performed REMOTE Jira writes during pending-binding recovery.

**Proven root cause** — `run_differs._run_differs_outbound` gated pending-binding recovery on `if not scoped_ids:` alone — no persist/no-write axis. On an unscoped no-write pass (persist=False, scoped_ids empty) the gate was truthy, so `binding_store.recover_pending_bindings(...)` ran, and its keyed-pending branch (binding_recovery.py:334-336) issued real `client.add_label(key, "rebar-id:<local>")` + `client.set_entity_property(key, "local_id", ...)` mutations of the remote issue. The sibling invariant-filing gate 20 lines up already composed both axes (`skip_invariant_filing = (not persist) or bool(scoped_ids)`), and reconcile.py's retirement write-boundary repair gates on `persist=/scoped=` — the recovery gate was asymmetric with the code beside it.

**Proof** — RED oracle drove `_run_differs_outbound` with a real `BindingStore` seeded with one keyed-pending binding (state=pending, jira_key=DIG-A) + a spy transport recording every remote write. persist=False unscoped pass → spy recorded `['add_label(DIG-A,rebar-id:loc-A)', 'set_entity_property(DIG-A,local_id)']` (RED — exactly the reported defect). Contrast oracle (persist=True) recorded the same two writes (recovery is live, proving the assertion is about the persist axis, not a dead path).

**Test** — `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_run_differs_recovery_no_write.py` (new). Seen RED first for the right reason (2 remote writes on a no-write pass); GREEN after fix (zero writes). Mutation check: the fix's own pre-image (`if not scoped_ids:`) IS the defect mutation → returns RED. Refactoring-litmus: asserts observable remote writes (the spy list), not internal names. Held-out contract, not source grep.

**Fix** — one line: `if not scoped_ids:` → `if not scoped_ids and ctx.persist:` (scoped check first so a scoped pass never depends on the persist axis; short-circuit keeps existing scoped-fake-ctx tests valid). No-write passes now perform zero remote recovery writes; live-pass recovery unchanged.

**Scope & safety** — Restoration not creation (removes an undocumented remote write on a no-write pass; adds nothing). No new dependency. No test weakened: two existing partial-fake-ctx tests (test_recovery_write_boundary source-grep + test_outbound_multi_project malformed-json) were kept passing by (a) ordering scoped-first to preserve their short-circuit and (b) rewording the comment to not contain the `repair_at_write_boundary` literal the source-grep test forbids — no assertions removed. Caller-dependency gate: clear — only no-write passes change; any caller relying on preview-time recovery was relying on the bug.

**Siblings** — Construct axis: the class is "remote-write side effect gated on scoped_ids without the persist axis." Swept the recovery/write gates in run_differs.py + reconcile.py; the only instance was this site. The invariant-filing gate (line 290) and `repair_at_write_boundary` (reconcile.py:299, `persist=/scoped=`) already compose both axes — references, not siblings. Parity axis: `recover_pending_bindings` has exactly ONE caller (run_differs:420, fixed); no CLI/MCP/library surface triggers recovery independently. All census slots present or N/A.

**Residual risk & prevention** — Observed but out of scope: `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_ref_lock.py::test_ac0_blob_ref_roundtrips_through_remote` fails identically on the clean origin/main baseline in this local sandbox (git `cat-file -t` → exit 128, an environmental/git-config issue). **Accepted** — pre-existing, unrelated to this defect, will run clean in CI.

**Replication** — The reported scenario (a no-write pass issuing remote writes during recovery) is exercised end-to-end at the exact function named in the report's evidence; it no longer reproduces (zero remote writes on persist=False).

AC coverage: AC#1 no-write→zero-writes ✓; AC#2 live-pass-unchanged contrast ✓; AC#3 create-recovery invariants unchanged (pinned by test_binding_recovery.py, untouched) ✓; AC#4 disposition (silent suppression, matching preview) documented in description ✓.
